rawContent: @IndieRevolver The thing that made Gibson fall out of grace in Hollywood had nothing to do with the #MeToo movement. It was also awful, his rant. But don't conflate the two.

@WeaponXKP21 @Burn0321 Part of it is also how outspoken Brie has been about wanting her press junkets to be more inclusive and diverse; part of it is that she's an active #MeToo and #TimesUp champion; part of it is embittered DC trolls jumping on the bandwagon.
